name: hlsl-dev
postCreateCommand:
set -eu
grep -qs 'devenv hook' ~/.bashrc || printf '\neval "$(devenv hook bash)"\n' >>~/.bashrc
grep -qs bashrc ~/.profile || printf '\n[ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ] && [ -f ~/.bashrc ] && . ~/.bashrc\n' >>~/.profile
git config --global --get-all safe.directory | grep -qx '\*' || git config --global --add safe.directory '*'
devenv allow
